                                                                                                                                                                    বৃহস্পতিবার 
                                                                                                                                                                    শুক্রবার 
                                                                                                                                                                    শনিবারB
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    2) E-র পরীক্ষা মঙ্গলবার এবং A-র ঠিক আগে।

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n\n\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\n
                                                                                                                                                                    সোমবারC
                                                                                                                                                                    মঙ্গলবারE
                                                                                                                                                                    বুধবারA
                                                                                                                                                                    বৃহস্পতিবার 
                                                                                                                                                                    শুক্রবার 
                                                                                                                                                                    শনিবারB
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    3) F-এর পরীক্ষা A-র ঠিক পরে এবং D-র ঠিক আগে।

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n\n\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\n
                                                                                                                                                                    সোমবারC
                                                                                                                                                                    মঙ্গলবারE
                                                                                                                                                                    বুধবারA
                                                                                                                                                                    বৃহস্পতিবারF
                                                                                                                                                                    শুক্রবারD
                                                                                                                                                                    শনিবারB
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    এখানে, আমরা দেখতে পাচ্ছি যে D-এর পরীক্ষা শুক্রবার।

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    অতএব, সঠিক উত্তর হল \"D\"।

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n275:Tc50,\n

                                                                                                                                                                    આપેલી માહિતી અનુસાર,

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    1) તેમાંના કોઈની પરીક્ષા C પહેલા અને B પછી નથી.

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n\n\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                    સોમવારC
                                                                                                                                                                    મંગળવાર 
                                                                                                                                                                    બુધવાર 
                                                                                                                                                                    ગુરુવારઆપેલી માહિતી અનુસાર,

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    1) તેમાંના કોઈની પરીક્ષા C પહેલા અને B પછી નથી.

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n\n\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\n
                                                                                                                                                                    સોમવારC
                                                                                                                                                                    મંગળવાર 
                                                                                                                                                                    બુધવાર 
                                                                                                                                                                    ગુરુવાર 
                                                                                                                                                                    શુક્રવાર 
                                                                                                                                                                    શનિવારB
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    2) E ની પરીક્ષા મંગળવારે અને A પહેલા તરત જ છે.

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n\n\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\n
                                                                                                                                                                    સોમવારC
                                                                                                                                                                    મંગળવારE
                                                                                                                                                                    બુધવારA
                                                                                                                                                                    ગુરુવાર 
                                                                                                                                                                    શુક્રવાર 
                                                                                                                                                                    શનિવારB
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    3) F ની પરીક્ષા A પછી તરત જ અને D પહેલા તરત જ છે.

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n\n\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\n
                                                                                                                                                                    સોમવારC
                                                                                                                                                                    મંગળવારE
                                                                                                                                                                    બુધવારA
                                                                                                                                                                    ગુરુવારF
                                                                                                                                                                    શુક્રવારD
                                                                                                                                                                    શનિવારB
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    અહીં, આપણે જોઈ શકીએ છીએ કે D ની પરીક્ષા શુક્રવારે છે.

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    આથી, સાચો જવાબ \"D\" છે.

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n276:Td48,\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ನೀಡಲಾಗಿರುವ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ,

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    1) C ಗಿಂತ ಮೊದಲು ಮತ್ತು B ಗಿಂತ ನಂತರ ಯಾರೂ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಲ್ಲ. 

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n\n\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                    ಸೋಮವಾರC
                                                                                                                                                                    ಮಂಗಳವಾರ 
                                                                                                                                                                    ಬುಧವಾರ 
                                                                                                                                                                    ನೀಡಲಾಗಿರುವ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ,

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    1) C ಗಿಂತ ಮೊದಲು ಮತ್ತು B ಗಿಂತ ನಂತರ ಯಾರೂ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಲ್ಲ. 

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n\n\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\n
                                                                                                                                                                    ಸೋಮವಾರC
                                                                                                                                                                    ಮಂಗಳವಾರ 
                                                                                                                                                                    ಬುಧವಾರ 
                                                                                                                                                                    ಗುರುವಾರ 
                                                                                                                                                                    ಶುಕ್ರವಾರ 
                                                                                                                                                                    ಶನಿವಾರB
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    2) E ನ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು ಮಂಗಳವಾರ ಮತ್ತು A ಗಿಂತ ಮೊದಲು ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. 

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n\n\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t\n
                                                                                                                                                                    ಸೋಮವಾರC
                                                                                                                                                                    ಮಂಗಳವಾರE
                                                                                                                                                                    ಬುಧವಾರA
                                                                                                                                                                    ಗುರುವಾರ 
                                                                                                                                                                    ಶುಕ್ರವಾರ 
                                                                                                                                                                    ಶನಿವಾರB
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    3) F ನ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು A ನ ನಂತರ ಮತ್ತು D ಗಿಂತ ಮೊದಲು ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x + y + z = (a − b) + (b − 2c) + (−a + 2c)

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ = a − b + b − 2c − a + 2c

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ = 0

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ਕਿਉਂਕਿ x + y + z = 0, ਪਛਾਣ ਦੁਆਰਾ, ਪੂਰੀ ਸਮੀਕਰਨ ਸਰਲ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x^3 + y^3 + z^3 = 3xyz

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 3 x (a − b) x (b − 2c) x (−a + 2c)

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ, ਜਵਾਬ ਹੈ:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ ਨਤੀਜਾ 3 x (a − b) x (b − 2c) x (−a + 2c) ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                    Given:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Length = 12 m

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Breadth = 10 m

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Height = 15 m

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Volume of a cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Volume = 12 m × 10 m × 15 m

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Volume = 1800 m3

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    The volume of the cuboid is 1800 m3.

                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    लंबाई = 12 m

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    चौड़ाई = 10 m

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ऊँचाई = 15 m

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    घनाभ का आयतन = लंबाई x चौड़ाई x ऊँचाई

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    आयतन = 12 m x 10 m x 15 m

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ आयतन = 1800 m3

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    घनाभ का आयतन 1800 m3 है।

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Given:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Father's age today = F

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Ages of the three children today = C1, C2, C3

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    1. F = 2 × (C1 + C2 + C3)

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    2. F + 15 = (C1 + 15) + (C2 + 15) + (C3 + 15)

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Let the sum of the ages of the three children today be S.

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    1. F = 2S

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    2. F + 15 = S + 45

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Substituting F from the first equation into the second equation:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 2S + 15 = S + 45

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 2S - S = 45 - 15

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ S = 30

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Now, substituting S back into the first equation:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ F = 2 × 30

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ F = 60

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Father's age today = 60 years

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Father's age 15 years from today = 60 + 15 = 75 years

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    The father is 75 years old 15 years from today.

                                                                                                                                                                    The logic followed here is:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Logic: Ratio of the two numbers of the pair is 5 ∶ 3.

                                                                                                                                                                    35 ∶ 21

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    → Ratio = 5 ∶ 3

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    20 ∶ 12

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    → Ratio = 5 ∶ 3

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    40 ∶ ?

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    → ? = 40 × 3/5 = 24

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Hence, the correct answer is "24".

                                                                                                                                                                    Formula used:

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Percentage increase = [(Size 8 sales - Size 9 sales) / Size 9 sales] × 100

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ = [1740 / 740] x 100

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ≈ 2.35 x 100
